snippet.title: Basketball Career Game & Management Simulator | Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend is a single-player basketball career game, RPG and management simulator for Windows PC. Build one player from college prospect to basketball legend while a living world changes around your career.

Wishlist on Steam and request Playtest access:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4968700/Hoop_Dynasty_Rise_of_a_Legend/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic_video&utm_campaign=evergreen_wishlist&utm_content=gameplay_trailer_v6

This official gameplay trailer shows the Locker Room, Live 2D Match Center, fast simulation, post-game growth, RPG choices, player profiles, team rosters and standings, media, awards, legacy and Selection Night.

Explore the basketball career game:
https://hoopdynasty.info/game.html?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic_video&utm_campaign=gameplay_trailer_v6

CHAPTERS
0:00 Game Day: Locker Room & Match Center
0:26 Final Buzzer & Player Growth
0:36 Career RPG & Life Off the Court
0:48 Player Profile, Teams & Standings
1:01 HD Network & Awards
1:14 Legacy & Selection Night
1:26 Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
1:40 Final Signal

A single-player basketball game for players who enjoy sports RPGs, management systems, player development and long-term career simulation.

All teams, players, leagues, awards, logos, names, histories and statistics are fictional.

#BasketballGame #IndieGame #PCGaming
